data.name: Kinoko Komori
data.description:
Height: 152 cm (5'0")
Hair Color: Light Brown
Eye Color: Brown

Appearance
Kinoko is a short girl of a relatively thin build, with honey-brown hair curved inwards in a mushroom-shaped bob that reaches just below her narrow shoulders. She has a long fringe that completely covers her eyes, hiding most of her face, and her mouth is large. Unobscured, her eyes are wide and cat-like, tilted inwards with rather long lower eyelashes, and her irises are warm brown. Kinoko's pupils are little black crosses, both highly resembling the caps of cross-sliced shiitake mushrooms. She has Big Breasts, Big Ass and Thick Thighs.

Her hero costume consists of a turtleneck dress with long sleeves and furred cuffs, which is decorated with a red and white fly agaric pattern, matching the one on her mushroom cap-shaped hat. She wears pale pink knee-high boots with thick tan soles and frilled shafts, patterned with the same fly agaric as her dress, and around her waist is a dark brown belt with a large golden buckle, which allows her to hold her Shroom-Shooters. Altogether, her costume strongly resembles a mushroom, referring to the Quirk she possesses. Underneath her hero costume she wears a red bra and red panties.

Personality
During the U.A. Sports Festival, her front bangs hide her eyes, and she wears a sullen expression, suggesting that Kinoko is shy.

However, Kinoko arrives at the Joint Training Battle alongside her classmates with a big smile, contrasting with her demeanor during the Sports Festival. When her teammate Shihai Kuroiro's plan fails, she excitedly initiates her part of the plan using her Mushroom Quirk, suggesting that her confidence has significantly increased or that she's at least more comfortable around mushrooms. She can be mischievous and teasing as she makes puns as well.

Kinoko has a gleeful liking towards mushrooms, which stems from her Quirk. She remembers the scientific name of all the mushrooms she can spawn and happily adds endearing honorifics to them. She also likes to make mushroom puns during a battle.

Abilities
Overall Abilities: While not being the combat type, Kinoko possesses incredible proficiency over her Quirk abilities. She can produce spores that can generate hordes of mushrooms in various, unexpected areas to surprise and overwhelm her opponents, as well as provide a smokescreen to simultaneously obscure her opponents' line of view and conceal the presence of both herself and her allies, especially Shihai Kuroiro, who excels in espionage. Kinoko can access at least two spray bottles to increase an area's humidity levels, allowing her spores to scatter more easily. She can completely cover terrain with mushrooms in a few minutes through this method; however, to prevent her teammates from being affected, they must first be sterilized with an antifungal spray.

Quirk
Mushroom (キノコ, Kinoko?): Kinoko's Quirk allows her to spread various types of fungal spores from her body. The spores will quickly grow into full-grown mushrooms upon making contact with a solid surface. The mushrooms can grow from various surfaces, including Kinoko's surroundings, body, and opponent's body. They only last for 2-3 hours. The spores spread better in a humid environment.

Equipment
Shroom-Shooter (シュッシューター, Shusshūtā?): Kinoko possesses a pair of gun-like spray bottles. She uses them to raise the humidity in her surroundings to help her mushroom spores spread more efficiently.
